svg.title: José Rodriguez: Tech Lead · Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
svg.desc: José Rodriguez, Tech Lead · Senior Full Stack AI Engineer based in Tepic, Nayarit, MX. I design AI-native development workflows and ship scalable web and mobile products, end to end. Stats: 8+ years building, 30+ products shipped, 40+ students mentored, 3.5K contributions · 12 mo, 1.7K pull requests merged.
